🎮 Controls:
Left ALT - Shift Lock (Y ON CONSOLE KBM)
R – Sub (B)
Q – Dash (LS Down)
F – Block (LT)
B - Gripping (DPad Down)
V - Carrying (DPad Left)
T – Equip Weapon (DPad Down)
X - Weapon Ability (Dpad Down + RB)
LMB – Light Attack (RT)
RMB(Airborne) - Heavy Attack (RB)
Air Starter – Ctrl + LMB (LB + RB)
G / H – Eye Activation (DPad Down + X)
